Have Swampert hold it, and this stone will enable it
to Mega Evolve during battle.
swampertite.name: swampertite
swampertite.shortEffect: Held: Allows Swampert to Mega Evolve into Mega Swampert.

tamato-berry.effect:
Used on a party Pokémon
:   Increases happiness by 10/5/2.  Lowers Speed effort by 10.
tamato-berry.flavorText:
POKéBLOCK ingredient.
Plant in loamy soil
to grow TAMATO.
tamato-berry.name: tamato-berry
tamato-berry.shortEffect: Drops Speed Effort Values by 10 and raises happiness.

tanga-berry.effect:
Held in battle
:   When the holder would take super-effective Bug-type damage, it consumes this item to halve the amount of damage taken.
tanga-berry.flavorText:
A Poffin ingredient. If held by a
Pokémon, it weakens a foe’s
supereffective Bug-type attack.
tanga-berry.name: tanga-berry
tanga-berry.shortEffect: Held: Consumed when struck by a super-effective Bug-type attack to halve the damage.

tapunium-z--held.effect: Held: Allows Tapu Koko, Tapu Lele, Tapu Bulu, and Tapu Fini to upgrade Nature’s Madness into Guardian of Alola.

the tapu’s Nature’s Madness to a Z-Move.
tapunium-z--held.name: tapunium-z--held
tapunium-z--held.shortEffect: Held: Allows the Tapus to upgrade Nature’s Madness into Guardian of Alola.

terrain-extender.effect: Held: When the holder changes the Terrain (whether by move or ability), it will last  8 turns instead of 5.
terrain-extender.flavorText:
An item to be held by a Pokémon. It extends the
duration of the terrain caused by the holder’s move
or Ability.
terrain-extender.name: terrain-extender
terrain-extender.shortEffect: Held: Extends the holder’s Terrain effects to 8 turns.

thick-club.effect: Held by Cubone or Marowak: Doubles the holder’s Attack.
thick-club.flavorText:
A bone of some
sort. It can be sold
cheaply.
thick-club.name: thick-club

throat-spray.flavorText:

move.
throat-spray.name: throat-spray

toxic-orb.effect: Held: Badly poisons the holder at the end of each turn.

the holder in battle.
toxic-orb.name: toxic-orb
toxic-orb.shortEffect: Held: Inflicts Toxic on the holder at the end of the turn. Activates after Poison damage would occur.

toxic-plate.effect:

power of Poison-type moves.
toxic-plate.name: toxic-plate
toxic-plate.shortEffect: Held: Poison-Type moves from holder do 20% more damage. Changes Arceus’s and Judgment’s type to Poison.

boosts PSYCHIC-

white-herb.effect:

A hold item that
restores any
lowered stat.

white-herb.shortEffect: Held: Resets all lowered stats to normal at end of turn. Consumed after use.

wide-lens.name: wide-lens

wiki-berry.flavorText:
A hold item that
restores HP but
may confuse.
wiki-berry.name: wiki-berry
wiki-berry.shortEffect: Held: Consumed at 1/2 max HP to restore 1/8 max HP. Confuses Pokémon that dislike dry flavor.
